episodes.title: Along Came a Goddess
episodes.synopsis: Azusa learns that a goddess is making a public appearance in the provincial capital and goes to check it out.

episodes.title: We Searched for an Undead
episodes.synopsis: Azusa takes Falfa and Shalsha to the World Spirit Conference. When they return, Beelzebub asks for a favor.

episodes.title: We Went to Beelzebub`s House
episodes.synopsis: When Beelzebub brags about her huge mansion, Azusa can't resist paying a visit to see it for herself.

episodes.title: We Went Looking for a Mandragora
episodes.synopsis: Azusa learns that mandragoras gain the ability to walk and talk after 300 years, so she goes to find one.

episodes.title: I Became Momma Yufufu`s Daughter
episodes.synopsis: After Azusa eats a mushroom that makes her shrink, Yufufu offers to be her mom for the day.

episodes.title: Laika Entered a Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.synopsis: Laika enters a martial arts tournament to help Fightie, who's hoping to win the prize money.

episodes.title: I Met a Pine Spirit
episodes.synopsis: Azusa tries to help a pine spirit whose temple has fallen on hard times due to a decrease in weddings.

episodes.title: We Went Swimming in the Sea
episodes.synopsis: Azusa takes her family to the ocean, where they meet a jellyfish spirit who also happens to be a painter.

episodes.title: We Met the Evil Spirit Queen
episodes.synopsis: Azusa and company try to get the queen of Thursa Thursa to come out of her tomb and rejoin her people.

episodes.title: We Went to the Demon King`s Birthday Party
episodes.synopsis: Pecora hosts a grand birthday party, but the only gift she wants is a day alone with Azusa.

episodes.title: I Battled a Traditional Goddess
episodes.synopsis: Mega-mega has caught the eye of Nintan, a goddess who favors tradition and rejects new ideas.

episodes.title: We Opened the Coffee Shop Again This Year
episodes.synopsis: It's time for Flatta's annual dance festival again, and The Witch's House makes its long-awaited return.

info.title: The Dinner Table Detective (ITA)
info.synopsis: Reiko Hosho è una ricca ereditiera di un conglomerato aziendale, però ha scelto di lavorare come apprendista detective e si impegna duramente in quello che fa. Non riesce a sopportare il suo superiore, il detective Kamatsuri, che sembra sempre fare deduzioni illogiche che trasformano ogni caso di omicidio in uno irrisolto. Un giorno il maggiordomo di Reiko annuncia improvvisamente il suo pensionamento e presenta Kageyama come suo sostituto. La ragazza nota subito che le capacità di deduzione del suo nuovo maggiordomo sono molto buone dopo che Kageyama ha risolto un caso che apparentemente sembrava impossibile. Da quel giorno Reiko, ogni volta che si trova davanti a casi dalla difficile risoluzione, espone tutti i dettagli al suo maggiordomo durante le cene. Kageyama di tutta risposta risolve sempre brillantemente ogni caso proposto, ma le sue spiegazioni sono sempre con un tono tagliente nei confronti della sua padrona...

related.title: The Dinner Table Detective

episodes.title: Welcome to the Murderous Party: File 1
episodes.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Reiko Hosho leads a double life as a novice detective. One day, an incident erupts at a birthday party she attends with friends from her college days. The victim is one of her old classmates, and Reiko's friends are labeled as suspects for matching the attacker's description. Stirring in confusion with only 20 minutes to solve the case, a man suddenly appears to reveal the culprit.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Murderous Party: File 2 / Here`s a Message from the Dead: File 1
episodes.synopsis: Mystery butler Kageyama concocts a peculiar plan to catch the criminal lurking in a luxury hotel, after which Reiko and her friends realize the hidden complexity of their own emotions. Reiko then tackles the murder case of a real estate tycoon. Each of the victim's relatives harbor suspicious motives to kill, but a single photograph proves essential in accelerating this perplexing investigation.

episodes.title: Here`s a Message from the Dead: File 2
episodes.synopsis: While investigating the murder of a real estate tycoon, Reiko examines an erased dying message, a bloody trophy, and a cord yanked from the curtains. Without proof, however, she reaches a dead end...until savage butler Kageyama emerges to solve the mystery. Reiko and Kyoichiro think outside the box to trap the murderer, peek inside the victim's mindset, and end a chain of events fueled by revenge.

episodes.title: Please Be Aware of Two-timing Affairs: File 1
episodes.synopsis: With Kageyama as her chauffeur, Reiko and her friends visit a crowded summer festival, where a cracked smartphone is discovered. Its owner was poisoned in his apartment, and he died wearing nothing but briefs. Three women the victim dated simultaneously on a matching app fail to match the height of a suspect seen exiting his residence, which leaves Reiko puzzled at the true culprit's identity.

episodes.title: Please Be Aware of Two-timing Affairs: File 2 / The Person Who Dropped It Is a VTuber: File 1
episodes.synopsis: Women of differing heights are spotted at the crime scene. Kageyama suspects that elevator shoes disguised the murderer's appearance. After learning that the victim had scammed several women via dating apps, Reiko inches closer to the truth. Later, a delivery man is found dead with an item belonging to his favorite VTuber, and it's discovered that the two even frequented the same hospital.

episodes.title: The Person Who Dropped It Is a VTuber: File 2
episodes.synopsis: After a delivery man falls to his death, Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate his connection to popular VTuber "Kuru Kuru-Chan," who is blamed for the murder by fans online. Kageyama assists in analyzing a mystery figure planting bugs, untouched food deliveries, and hints to the true culprit left at the crime scene. The victim leaves a note reading, "I've had enough of this world," but in what context?

episodes.title: There Is No Such Thing as a Completely Locked Room: File 1
episodes.synopsis: A famous painter is stabbed in his own studio, pointing to his masterpiece wall painting "Sleeping Beauty" just before dying. Suspects include his art-jacking son, his second wife, and an art magazine writer with whom he supposedly had an affair. Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate how the killer escaped a locked studio, eventually learning of the victim's connection to a certain "Appraisal Queen."

episodes.title: There Is No Such Thing as a Completely Locked Room: File 2 / Please Don`t Drown in This River: File 1
episodes.synopsis: Kageyama locates a secret passageway to solve the locked-room murder mystery. Upon encountering a deranged woman wielding a knife, Reiko is left with nowhere to escape. On the next case, a white-suited journalist's body is discovered by the river. Despite being dry, his cause of death is drowning. With debts to pay, he had targeted a well-known "Shaketopia" actress whom Reiko adored as a child.

episodes.title: Please Don`t Drown in This River: File 2
episodes.synopsis: Journalist Ryota Ishiguro's body is found on the riverbank, but although the cause of his death is drowning, the body is dry. Reiko's investigations lead her to Shiho and Satoshi Kambara, a loving couple from whom Ishiguro had been demanding money, but they claim to have an alibi. The discovery of a silver spoon with the engraving "Shiho to Leo" takes the case in an unexpected direction.

episodes.title: Murder Lies in a Beautiful Rose
episodes.synopsis: A woman's body is found in a bed of blooming roses at the prestigious Fujikura residence. The victim is Toshio Fujikura's fiancée, and the suspects include members of the family. Reiko, who happens to be their neighbor, is fearful that her identity will be exposed. As the investigation continues, they discover that the victim's pet cat is missing, which may be a key to solving the case.

episodes.title: The Bride Is Behind Locked Doors
episodes.synopsis: Reiko attends the wedding of Sawamura Yuri, who she cherishes like a younger sister. The groom is Hosoyama, a consultant for a family friend. When Yuri is attacked and gravely injured in her room during the party, Reiko risks her identity being revealed to help solve the case. But when the crime scene is found to be a perfect locked room, Reiko is suspected of being an accomplice.

episodes.title: What Is It That You Have Lost?
episodes.synopsis: Trouble strikes the Sawamura family again when Miyuki Sawamura is kidnapped and a ransom of 50 million yen is demanded. With no other suspects, Reiko sets her sights on Hosoyama. She takes Kageyama to the ransom handover disguised as a couple. Despite the perpetrator's traps, they inch closer to the truth, and find that the case is connected to an incident that occurred three years prior.

info.title: Pugyuru
info.synopsis: Un giorno, una normale studentessa delle superiori, Ma$%^&* (il suo nome è lasciato alla tua immaginazione), incontrò Cheko, una cameriera proveniente da un villaggio di cameriere. Poteva sciogliersi, volare e staccarsi la testa... Comunque, iniziarono ad arrivare persone strane, per esempio una fata della neve che odiava il freddo, un enorme calamaro parlante, persone spaventose e simili.

episodes.title: Squid... I Mean... My Name is Nachiko

info.title: Pupipo!
info.synopsis: La storia di incentra su Wakaba Himeji, una bambina della quinta elementare che può vedere cose che gli altri non sono in grado di vedere. In genere si tratta di spiriti maligni che tendono a fare del male alle persone che la circondano. Quindi il suo potere finisce per spaventarla, e farla tenere alla larga dalle altre persone, preferendo condurre una triste esistenza solitaria. Un giorno incontra una entità tutta rosa, paffuta e soffice, che urla “Pupipo!”. Da allora la sua vita non sarà più la stessa Po-chan la proteggerà dagli altri mostri e la aiuterà a trovare degli amici.

episodes.title: Wakaba and the Sunset and the Mysterious Creature
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba Himeji, a fifth grader, has been strongly inspired since she was a child and is always obsessed with ghosts. Because of that, my classmates made me creepy and I was living lonely days. One day, Wakaba meets a mysterious pink creature that screams "Pupipou" on his way home.

episodes.title: Call Me Az!
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba has come to live with the mysterious creature Po-chan. Reiko Higashi, a transfer student who loves occultism, is also interested in Wakaba, and every day becomes a little brighter. However, the ghosts who are not interested in it start to surprise A-chan ...?

episodes.title: The Sunset of Youth
episodes.synopsis: Ameyama, a classmate who always harasses Wakaba, is upset by A-chan, saying, "You really like Wakaba, right?" Due to the actions taken by Ameyama, the situation rolls in an unexpected direction ...?

episodes.title: Dark Sunday
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba came to the park with her to do a psychic spot survey. A big ghost with a raw neck appears there, and the excited A-chan makes the ghost angry. Po-chan was absent on that day, and a big tragedy would occur.

episodes.title: Next Stop, the Afterlife
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba who came to "the world" with Po-chan's mysterious ability to save the dying A-chan. A-chan, who absolutely wants to live, and Wakaba, who absolutely wants to help her friends. As the time limit approaches, will their wishes arrive ...?

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Apart
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba witnesses another classmate, Naoya Yuki, confronting a ghost. Yuki may have the same ability as himself. Wakaba, who is familiar with the suffering, calls out to Yuki.

episodes.title: Unseen Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba is worried because she doesn't know what to do with Yuki who doesn't listen even if she talks to her. Meanwhile, the girls in the class start teasing Wakaba, aiming for the day when A-chan took a rest due to a cold. Yuki and Ameyama who witnessed the scene took unexpected actions ...?

episodes.title: A Light in the Darkness
episodes.synopsis: Since touching Po-chan, Yuki has been worried about Po-chan appearing in her dreams. In that dream, Po says there is a place where he can abandon his ability to afflict himself. Wakaba hears the story and proposes a drastic proposal to Yuki.

episodes.title: Before Summer
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba invites her to her home to find a clue to solve Yuki's suffering. However, Yuki, who met Po-chan, seems to be terribly frightened and refuses to approach. Meanwhile, Po-chan muttered a key word.

episodes.title: The End of Oblivion
episodes.synopsis: A place where you can throw away what you want to throw away, "the end of the loss". Wakaba and his friends enter the summer vacation and visit their dad's teacher, Mr. Bakusan, to see the key picture of the place. Beyond that, Wakaba and his friends will take a big step.

episodes.title: In the Land of Falling Light
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba and Yuki have come to the mysterious world of "the end of the loss" where fragments of light fall. When I was looking for A-chan who had fallen apart, I met residents from another world. And Wakaba is predicted by them to be destined with Po-chan.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba and Yuki hear about the mechanism of "the end of the loss" from the alien inhabitants, Haru, a bird man, and Gueroro Gero, a frog. The fact makes them very confused. On the other hand, A-chan was in a big pinch by the dictator Amanas.

episodes.title: The Spring of Reincarnation
episodes.synopsis: Wakaba and Yuki arrive at the "Reincarnation Fountain", a place where they can be reborn as they wish. There, I hear A-chan's voice and know that it is a dangerous situation. The two begin to move to save A-chan, who was captured in the castle of Amanas.

info.title: Double Circle
info.synopsis: La storia si ambienta in una ideale riproduzione della città di Kawasaki ma in costante e continua evoluzione nei campi dell'energia, dell'ambiente e dell'economia grazie alle tecnologie ICT (Information and Communication Tecnlogies). Cinque eroi difendono la città dagli attacchi di vari invasori provenienti da un mondo esterno in cui il tempo si è fermato.

episodes.title: Illusion and Reality
episodes.synopsis: Far from the action of Asagi and his crew in Kawasaki, a tea party at a mysterious castle deep in the forest, sets the stage for Episode 5. Watch the mystery unfold.

info.title: Marry Me, Let's Have a Baby!
info.synopsis: "Sposami... ma solo se facciamo un bambino!". Durante un evento di speed-dating, Taika entra subito in sintonia con Ayano, una brillante dottoressa con un grande desiderio: avere un figlio. I due sembrano destinati a diventare una coppia, ma proprio prima che vengano annunciati gli abbinamenti, Taika va nel panico. I suoi timori legati alla disfunzione erettile riemergono e lo spingono a fuggire dall'evento. Qualche giorno dopo, Taika si presenta a un appuntamento medico per affrontare il suo problema... ma con enorme sorpresa scopre che la dottoressa incaricata è proprio Ayano! Come se non bastasse, si accorge che in sua presenza il suo disturbo scompare del tutto. Spinti dalla chimica inaspettata e da un obiettivo comune, i due decidono di stringere un patto segreto: un matrimonio contrattuale con lo scopo di avere un bambino entro un anno.

info.title: Dokidoki! Pretty Cure – Il film Mana si sposa!! L’abito della speranza che si collega al futuro
info.synopsis: Mana riceve l’abito da sposa che in passato fu indossato dalla madre e, a sua volta, dalla nonna. Discutendo con le amiche sui loro giorni di scuola elementare, Mana ricorda un cane di nome Mallow, che morì investito da un’auto. Quella notte, un uomo misterioso di nome Marsh utilizza un clarinetto per richiamare gli oggetti dimenticati e scartati che ancora si sentono utili, e li unisce insieme in un gigantesco dirigibile che vola via..

The Blue Orchestra 2

episodes.title: Coming Apart
episodes.synopsis: The Orchestra club has given their regular concert, and next will be the national competition. They will aim to continue their string of victories, but now with just the first and second-years. However, during the morning practice on the first day, the number of violins was surprisingly small. Furthermore, Sakuma, the leader of percussion, provokes new concertmaster Hatori and the members of the string instruments with harsh words. Aono is confused, and Saeki and Ritsuko are angry.

episodes.title: Ripples
episodes.synopsis: Takimoto, who was transferred from the first violin section to become the leader of the second violin section, has been skipping morning practice. At meetings, Sakuma and the others criticize him for not showing up despite being in a position to lead the section, but Takimoto continues to evade the question and doesn't explain the reason. Eventually, the frustration of the second violin section members explodes, and they confront Takimoto. Aono witnesses this. Takimoto leaves, saying something meaningful, and leaves. Then, Susono, who is worried about Takimoto, makes an unexpected suggestion.

episodes.title: Responsibility
episodes.synopsis: On his way home from school, Aono unexpectedly bumps into Takimoto, who is crying alone in pain. As Aono shows concern for his senior, Takimoto slowly begins to speak. He talks about the events surrounding the club member who quit, and his own cold feelings and confusion after no longer finding meaning in club activities. These feelings overlap with Aono's, who once gave up the violin due to his relationship with his father. Aono talks about the pain he felt when he stopped playing, and how his feelings toward his father are different now than they were back then. Aono's words make Takimoto decide.

episodes.title: Sports Day
episodes.synopsis: With two months until the competition, the string instruments are beginning to come together under the guidance of concertmaster Hatori, and the sports festival is upon us. Ritsuko, a member of the inter-club relay team, is inspired by Aono's determination to have fun and give it her all as she competes. However, she is also chosen as the class's leader for the horse-riding battle. Aono is timid, and Saeki, who is also competing in the battle, becomes competitive. Haru, who can't help but root for Aono, who is in a different group, asks him a question that has been bothering her for a while.

episodes.title: Issues
episodes.synopsis: There is one month until the competition. With the entire band still unable to agree on an interpretation of the piece, they split into three groups and begin block practice, with Aono ending up in the same group as Sakuma. "Bacchanale" from Saint-Saëns' opera "Samson and Delilah" depicts the love and hate between a man and a woman amidst an antagonistic relationship. It is filled with elegance and charm, anger and sadness, lies and secrets. Haru, who is in a different group from Aono, grasps something from a conversation with Machii, a third-year senior who knows how Haru feels about Aono.

episodes.title: Regret and Progress
episodes.synopsis: Tachibana, who is in the same group as Ritsuko during block practice, is irritated by the other members of the club who refuse to take the initiative. Ritsuko senses that Tachibana is always conscious of Sakuma, a senior from the same junior high school. Tachibana tells Ritsuko about how he took over as captain from Sakuma at the junior high school orchestra club, which was a regular gold medalist in competitions, and about the bitter experience and regret he had when his own enthusiasm and sense of responsibility didn't translate into results. Tachibana and Ritsuko are tuning their instruments together. Sakuma is playing the timpani in a separate room.

episodes.title: Competition
episodes.synopsis: And then the real competition arrives. Kaimaku High School is aiming for their ninth consecutive victory, while rival schools are determined to win this year. Ritsuko, who says that everyone looks good in their unfamiliar uniforms, is encouraged by Tachibana. Sakuma and Tsutsui renew their secret resolve to not run away from past regrets. Amid quiet tension and excitement, what supports each member is the days they poured all their passion into music. Harada and the other third-year students watch from the audience. With the call of "One sound, one encounter," the curtain rises on the new orchestra club.

episodes.title: Bacchanale
episodes.synopsis: The Kaimaku High School Orchestra Club has overcome differences in motivation among its members and discord over interpretations of the pieces they are performing by seriously competing with each other. Now they are taking on the competition, a stage where performances are judged on their merits. They have discovered the "anger" they feel in the story of "Bacchanale," which depicts the love and hate between Samson and Delilah. Aono and his friends play with all their might, filled with emotion and emotion, a sound that can only be produced in this moment. Will they be able to achieve their ninth consecutive national victory?

episodes.title: Identity
episodes.synopsis: After the competition is over and there are no club activities, Aono and Haru go out together. Their destination is a music store that Aono has been going to since he was a child.

episodes.title: Present
episodes.synopsis: Ritsuko calls Aono to ask for a favor. She wants to give him a performance of Bach's "Concerto for Two Violins," Aono's mother's favorite, as a birthday present. Just like in middle school, Ritsuko tutors Aono, and Aono teaches her violin. On his birthday, Aono is excited to visit a girl's room for the first time. Ritsuko's mother is curious about Aono, whom she's meeting for the first time. The two begin playing. The sound of the violin holds special meaning in the relationship between Ritsuko and her mother.

episodes.title: Choir
episodes.synopsis: Aono, Ritsuko, and Haru. Confused by their fluctuating feelings, the three of them continue to act as usual. Aono receives help from Ritsuko and Haru in his studies and finishes his final exams. The orchestra club's next performance is a Christmas concert held jointly with the choir club. Not only will the choir members sing along with the orchestra, but the orchestra members will also join in on some songs. Aono is embarrassed to sing in front of people and struggles with the unfamiliar songs. Then, a dignified voice resonates. Who is that voice?

episodes.title: Morning Mist
episodes.synopsis: Saeki heads to school early in the morning. The sky is at dawn, the air is cold. On a quiet winter morning, the voice of "Ave Maria" playing from his earphones brings back memories of his childhood in Germany with his mother.

episodes.title: Christmas Concert
episodes.synopsis: The Christmas concert, a joint performance with the choir club, opened with the orchestra members also singing "Joy to the World." The voices resonated along with the majestic pipe organ. Ritsuko's mother was overwhelmed by the powerful sound that vibrated through her entire body. Aono's mother was also there. Next came "Ave Maria." As she played, Saeki was enveloped in warm memories of her mother. Then came the magnificent "Hallelujah Chorus." A sense of profound accomplishment remained in Aono's heart. After the performance, the cold rain had somehow turned into snow.

episodes.title: New Scenery
episodes.synopsis: January 1st is Aono's birthday. Aono's new year begins with a visit to the shrine with Ritsuko, Haru, Saeki, and Yamada. Then comes the first club activity after the winter break.

episodes.title: Genroku Iwatora
episodes.synopsis: Aono and his friends pass the audition and become members of the junior orchestra. However, many of the successful applicants are students from high schools attached to music colleges.

episodes.title: A Distinguished Father
episodes.synopsis: The heat radiating from Iwato's entire body guides the sound. Aono and the others hang on desperately to the strict instruction. The piece is Akutagawa Yasushi's "Music for Symphony Orchestra."

episodes.title: Respective Signs
episodes.synopsis: Valentine's Day is a time when chocolates fly all over the school. The orchestra club members are also in high spirits. Aono is upset when he discovers chocolate hidden in his desk. He also realizes that Ritsuko, who had been handing out chocolates to everyone, hasn't given him any.

episodes.title: True Nature
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Junior Orchestra, who will be representing Japan in the competition, are all strong-willed individuals who want to pursue a career in music. Among them, Subaru Yukito, who sits in the concertmaster's seat, has a presence that seems to have poured everything into music, and Aono is overwhelmed by it.

episodes.title: Surpass
episodes.synopsis: The auditions were held in pairs, and it was Aono and Haru's turn. The highly synchronized performance of the two astounded the judges.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.synopsis: March, when the cherry blossoms bloom, is the season of departure. There's a graduation ceremony and a graduation party for the orchestra club. In their fleeting conversation, the feelings of those leaving and those seeing them off intertwine. Through their sometimes violent clashes, they achieve growth and create music.

info.title: Death Hall
info.synopsis: Special trasmesso sul canale youtube ufficiale della Shinchosha per commemorare il centesimo capitolo e ventesimo volume della serie "Shiyakusho". L'episodio adatterà il capitolo "Ashita no Watashi".

info.title: Oedo Fire Slayer: The Legend of Phoenix
info.synopsis: Matsunaga Gengo, un tempo conosciuto come “l’Uccello divorafiamme”, era il miglior samurai pompiere di Edo. Dopo aver lasciato la brigata per motivi personali, riceve un invito a servire il clan Shinjo. Tuttavia, la squadra antincendio del clan è povera, senza uomini e derisa dagli altri. Spronato dalla moglie Miyuki, Gengo decide di ricostruire il corpo in rovina e ne diventa il capo. Insieme a compagni eccentrici, affronta con coraggio l’obiettivo di “salvare ogni vita”, anche se vengono disprezzati come i “Boro-Tobi-Gumi” (gli “scalcinati steeplejacks”). Nel frattempo, a Edo si diffonde una serie di misteriosi incendi sospetti, noti come i “fuochi delle volpi”.

episodes.title: Under the Flowering Sky

info.title: Kuroko’s Basketball: It is the Best Present (ITA)
info.synopsis: Poche settimane dopo la Winter Cup, i cinque giocatori della Generazione dei miracoli, sono tornati di nuovo alla vita di tutti i giorni, fin quando non ricevono un invito da Momoi. La ragazza propone agli ex giocatori della Teiko, di riunirsi ancora una volta per giocare una partita. Kuroko accetta volentieri l’invito inaspettato. Ma Kagami è infastidito quando viene a saperlo, perché in quello stesso giorno, la squadra del Seirin stava progettando una festa di compleanno per Kuroko! Tuttavia, Kagami dice a Kuroko che la festa di compleanno non inizierà prima sera, e che dovrebbe approfittarne per rivedere i suoi vecchi amici. Quindi, il 31 gennaio, il giorno migliore di Kuroko ha inizio!

info.title: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
info.synopsis: Che cosa può fare una cameriera alle prime armi quando si ritrova improvvisamente bloccata in Giappone per un anno? Mangiare, naturalmente! Segui Suzume Tachibana, maid in addestramento, mentre si avventura tra ogni sorta di prelibatezza giapponese: dai dolci come il taiyaki e il melonpan agli spuntini salati come il takoyaki e gli onigiri. Ma attenzione: mentre Suzume soddisfa il suo appetito boccone dopo boccone, potrebbe finire per stuzzicare anche il tuo!

episodes.title: Soft Serve / Plum Wine / Barley Tea / Crepe / Raw Egg over Rice

episodes.synopsis: Ricotta invites Suzume to go to the pool, but the pool is closed! Suzume gets shaved ice to cheer them up.

episodes.title: New Rice / Curry / Roasted Sweet Potato / Grapes / Menchi Katsu

episodes.title: Miso Soup / Ginkgo / Halloween

episodes.title: Thousand-Year Candy / Corn Soup / Hiking / Mikan / Meat Bun
episodes.synopsis: Suzume is curious about the special candy the girl has at the park and goes hiking to enjoy the autumn leaves.

episodes.title: Stollen / Cachi / Yuzu / Torta di Natale
episodes.synopsis: Christmas season is here! Suzume serves stollen to Nana and Anzu because they've never had it before.

episodes.title: Gyoza / Daikon essiccato / Ramen istantaneo / Toshikoshi soba
episodes.synopsis: It's the end of the year! Suzume makes dried daikon and enjoys year-end soba with Ricotta, Anzu and Nana.

info.title: Dimension Movement of Nazca (ITA)
info.synopsis: Alla ricerca di un lontano passato e sulle tracce del suo maestro di Kendo, l'affascinante Masanari Tate, improvvisamente recatosi in Sud America, Kyoji Miura parte con Yuka, promessa sposa di Tate, per il Perù. Qui scopre che gli uomini-anima, reincarnazioni di potenti guerrieri un tempo divisi da vicende di politica e sangue, si stanno risvegliando, mentre in Giappone quelli che da sempre considerava i suoi più cari amici si stanno dividendo in due opposte fazioni. Chi è il guerriero Yawal, e per quale motivo brama la morte del guerriero Vilka? Chi erano, nel passato? E chi sono, in questo presente incapace di offrire certezze?
